QuestInfo.name: Eurenth's Favorites 1
QuestInfo.1: Eurenth is very sensitive to the cold. Get #b50 Yellow Speeyor Fur Coats#k from the #rYellow Speeyors#k in #bYellow Speeyor's Pasture#k.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Eurenth a gift, but he is still ignoring you.
